subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new public prompt-identity config surface for the main-agent opener, and should the supported API be identityLine/identityMode rather than another shape?
rationale: Current main proves the problem remains, but adding prompt config is a public operator contract and root policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces.

options.title: Accept Narrow Identity Config
options.body: Adopt the active identityLine/identityMode direction after refresh, docs/schema metadata, tests, and explicit default compatibility proof.

options.title: Choose A Different Core Shape
options.body: Keep the issue open but redirect the PR toward a SOUL-aware neutral default or another maintainer-approved API shape.

options.title: Reject New Prompt Config
options.body: Close the prompt-config direction and document the supported alternative, such as provider prompt contributions or workspace persona guidance.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Identity Config
recommendation.body: Adopt the active identityLine/identityMode direction after refresh, docs/schema metadata, tests, and explicit default compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about prompt/config product surface, and steipete has the strongest recent history across both affected paths.
